summary: PROMPT 11.6 (Captura de evidencia con Leaflet/OpenStreetMap) validated end-to-end. 8/8 unit tests in test_evidences.py pass + 1 new cross-tenant isolation test added and passing. Live API e2e against the public ingress confirms upload/list/serve/delete + RBAC + bad-mime rejection. Frontend Playwright walkthrough on the seeded ticket exercises the full flow: EvidenceCard render -> modal open -> Leaflet map init (8 OSM tiles, NO 'already initialized' StrictMode error) -> click drops pin -> file input + image preview -> upload -> thumbnail via authenticated fetch -> admin delete. Zero console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: models/evidence.py: EvidenceMeta XOR rule (ticket_id ^ claim_id) + lat/lng range validation done declaratively via Pydantic model_validator — clean and centralized. ALLOWED_MIME whitelist + MAX_BYTES=10MB enforced at the route level.

repositories/evidences.py: atomic write (tmp + rename) + per-tenant directory layout {EVIDENCE_ROOT}/{tenant}/{kind}/{owner}/{id}.{ext} is correct; safe_ext() guards against path traversal and exotic extensions; insert_one drops _id before returning.

routes/evidences.py: tenant scoping is done correctly via repo(tenant_id=user.tenant_id). Cross-tenant isolation verified — list returns 0 items, /file returns 404, DELETE returns 404 for non-owner tenant. file_path is always stripped before serializing to clients (verified on both upload response and list response).
routes/evidences.py L153: ROLE_RANK comparison for admin+ delete bypass works as expected — uploader OR role>=admin can delete.
routes/evidences.py L157-163: expediente.evidencia_ids guard prevents accidental deletion of evidence currently attached to an active claim — returns 409 TERMINAL_STATE (verified).

EvidenceCard.jsx: imperative L.map() pattern with mapRef guard (`if (!containerRef.current || mapRef.current) return;`) plus cleanup via m.remove() correctly survives React 18 StrictMode double-mount — confirmed live in the preview, no 'Map container is already initialized' runtime errors. Tile loading from tile.openstreetmap.org works (8 tiles loaded in viewport).
EvidenceCard.jsx: thumbnails are loaded with authenticated fetch + URL.createObjectURL pattern — correct for a Bearer-protected /file endpoint. Object URLs are revoked on unmount.

EvidenceCard.jsx: disabled=true correctly hides both 'Agregar evidencia' button (L114) and per-item 'Borrar' (L197), implementing the terminal-state UX rule. RBAC for admin-vs-uploader delete is enforced server-side; UI shows the trash icon to everyone, which is fine because the API is the source of truth.

Minor (cosmetic): EvidenceCard.jsx EvidenceItem useEffect cleanup uses `if (src) URL.revokeObjectURL(src)` referencing a stale closure of `src` — works in practice because state setter triggers re-run, but a ref-based cleanup would be slightly more robust. Not a functional bug.
Minor (informational): upload endpoint returns `tenant_id` in the public response; not strictly a leak (caller already knows their own tenant) but consider stripping it like file_path for symmetry.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 test_evidences.py + 1/1 test_evidences_cross_tenant.py + live ingress upload/list/serve/delete/422-bad-mime/401-no-auth all green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (EvidenceCard renders in TicketDetail; modal Leaflet map initializes with OSM tiles; pin-drop, file preview, upload, thumbnail, admin delete all functional; zero console/page errors)
